properties.statement: [BL-187] The corpus records WHEN something was true and nothing computes whether it still is — two folders, 1,300 files, one hole, and EIA-649 names it: STATUS ACCOUNTING
properties.value: {"evidence": "*Same field report, 2026-08-04, and the strongest cross-cutting finding in it \u2014 measured, not asserted.* Of 195 evidence writeups, 150 pin a commit SHA \u2014 they are honest about their anchor \u2014 across 175 distinct commits. Median pin is 117 commits behind main, oldest 1,885. Only 90 of 175 (51%) are still ancestors of origin/main: squash-merge replaced the branch commits, so half this corpus names trees that can no longer be rebuilt. The evidence stays true about what it tested; you can no longer reconstruct what it tested, and nothing anywhere computes the distance \u2014 a reader sees a confident PASS with no signal it was proven 117 commits ago. The same hole, twice more in this repo's own reading: 11 verifications sitting green on one batch run all stamped 2026-07-25T18:49:11Z, and maturity_report's assurance band counting passing while saying nothing about WHEN. Candidate: an external anchor \u2014 anchor_kind (vcs_commit / release / image_digest) plus anchor_ref \u2014 on TemporalFact / Verification / Artifact, so a report can say *\"passing, anchored to a commit 117 behind main\"*. reflow2's time axis is INTERNAL (DesignEpoch, which someone must create and remember to close) and this evidence anchors to EXTERNAL reality, which is more objective and which the graph cannot hold. Withdrawn on the way here and worth keeping on the record: the reporter proposed an Attestation node type off a three-file sample, read deeper, and killed it themselves \u2014 TemporalFact already expresses \"a claim that held at a time\". CAUTION FILED WITH THE ROW: the same report claims reflow2 is *\"already ~80% of the way there\"* on ISO/IEC/IEEE 15289 \u2014 the one place it drops its own evidence standard, a conformance claim asserted rather than measured. Compute the mapping before that is said anywhere public. Size M", "origin": "Migrated from docs/backlog.md BL-187 on 2026-08-07 (epoch:backlog-retired). Size estimate carried from the row: M."}
